title: VTRS Q3 2026 deep dive: new product launches and Pacira acquisition shape outlook
summary: Medication company Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales flat year on year at $3.75 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $14.8 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.71 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
